desc: Build or analytics project, about 14 steps, 3-8 weeks.

steps.t: Write scope statement and out-of-scope list
Define acceptance criteria for every deliverable
Estimate as a range with declared buffer
steps.n: Best, likely and worst case plus the declared buffer.

steps.g: no DO task starts until this is finished

steps.n: Critical path: outputs are only as good as the inputs.
Check progress against the estimate and re-check the top risks.

steps.t: Verify figures and behaviour against source data and acceptance criteria
Write lessons learned into the knowledge base
Adjust estimation notes from actual vs estimate

name: build
